'''Jason Luminella''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 9th at [[August 2000 Glenside tournament]] on 27 August 2000, according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1166">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-glenside-pa-8-27-00d1166/ glenside-pa-8-27-00], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 27 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-27-glenside-pa-8-27-00d1166/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
